messages:
Maya: Quick ops sync for Tuesdaylaunch webinar. Need owners for reg page variants, Zoom fallback, captions/transcripts, recording splits, and HubSpot routing. Short list: test RTMP, verify hidden UTMs, caption QC, and follow-up cadence.

Ethan: Ill own HubSpot + lead routing. Will add hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, ab_variant. Zap will create/update contact and attach activity 'webinar_launch_apr'. Will test and report.

Sam: RTMP fallback here. Set primary as Zoom cloud recording, fallback to StreamYard RTMP. I'll test keys tonight and do dress rehearsal 09:00 PT tomorrow. Obs settings: 3500k, 2s keyframe, 1280x720.

Priya: I'll handle reg copy + follow-ups. Draft two hero variants (benchmark vs demo). Follow-up cadence: replay 1h, highlights + PDF 24h, nurture 72h. Will A/B test subjects on internal list.

Luis: Captions/transcript owner. Turn on Zoom auto-captions live, then post-process SRT -> VTT + speaker labels, output to s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-04/. Run quick WER check and flag if >5%.

Maya: Great. If live >10min delay: Sam flips RTMP, Priya updates reg banner, Ethan triggers opt-in SMS. Everyone confirm when complete. :rocket:
